title: Local globalization of a map that is C¹ on an open set (bump-function cutoff)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^k open, χ : ℝ^k → ℝ^P of class C¹ on W (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ W), and y ∈ W. Then there exist g : ℝ^k → ℝ^P and ε > 0 such that the open ball B_ε(y) is contained in W, g is of class C¹ on all of ℝ^k (ContDiff ℝ 1 g), and g = χ on B_ε(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid k)) (χ : Euclid k → Euclid P) (y : Euclid k), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ W → y ∈ W → ∃ (g : Euclid k → Euclid P) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ ball y ε ⊆ W ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ EqOn g χ (ball y ε)
